scenes.description: A dim, quiet hallway on the third floor of a plain communist-era government building in Pyongyang. A single unremarkable door with no nameplate or sign, bare fluorescent light overhead, worn linoleum floor, muted institutional green-gray walls.
Motion graphic: dark satellite-style map of North Korea, a glowing red circle pulses over Pyongyang, camera pushes in as text 'ROOM 39' fades in.

A young Kim Jong Il as heir apparent in 1972, seated at a plain wooden desk in a dim office, papers and an old rotary phone in front of him, pensive troubled expression, single desk lamp casting warm light against the cool dark room.
Close up of neat stacks of foreign currency (US dollars, euros) on a dark table, a faint barred-window shadow falling across them suggesting sanctions/restriction, cool moody lighting.

Infographic built in Remotion: three labeled doors in a row on a single floor plan — 'Office 35' (intelligence), 'Office 38' (legal money), 'Room 39' (unmarked, glowing) — simple flat vector diagram, muted palette matching grade.
Inside a hidden industrial room, an old currency printing press running, sheets of banknotes rolling off it, dim green-shaded work lamps, two silhouetted workers tending the machine.

A busy North Korean city street collage feel: a trading company storefront, a mining operation in the distance, a textile factory with smoke stacks, and a small restaurant sign in a foreign city — everyday commerce look, muted color palette, nothing dramatic.

Close-up on a garment factory worker's hands sewing a clothing label; one label reads 'MADE IN NORTH KOREA' being unpicked, a second label reading 'MADE IN CHINA' ready to be sewn on in its place, focused overhead work-lamp light.
A pair of hands holding a $100 bill up to a bright desk lamp, inspecting it closely with a loupe, suspicious close scrutiny, dark office background, high contrast light on the bill.

Split composition: an intaglio printing plate and a genuine US Treasury press on one side, a stack of near-identical counterfeit bills stamped 'SUPERNOTE' in evidence-bag lighting on the other, forensic examination mood.

A somber office in Pyongyang: a state insurance official stamping and sealing a claim document to be mailed to Europe, a globe on the desk turned toward Europe, cold fluorescent lighting, bureaucratic and quiet.

A European insurance boardroom, executives around a table reviewing documents, a wired transfer of a large sum being authorized, tense resigned expressions, cool corporate lighting, muted blues and grays.
An industrial state-linked chemical facility interior, glass drums and lab equipment, workers in masks monitoring production, harsh fluorescent overhead light, cold clinical color grade.
A small dim rural North Korean home, a person by candlelight looking at a small paper packet, worn simple room, sympathetic and quiet mood, warm low light against cold blue background.

A foreign construction site at dusk, silhouettes of North Korean laborers working long hours, a restaurant kitchen glimpse and a factory floor in smaller inset framing, tired resigned postures, muted amber and gray tones.

A dark room lit only by multiple glowing computer monitors, a hooded figure typing, abstract lines of code and a faint cracked film-studio clapperboard icon and cryptocurrency coin icon reflected in the screens, cool blue glow, high contrast.
Match-cut motion graphic built in Remotion: an old typewriter/rotary phone morphs/dissolves into a laptop keyboard, same lighting and vignette carried through the transition.

A middle-aged North Korean defector, Ri Jong-ho, in a plain interview room, serious and composed expression, a small South Korean flag barely visible in the background, warm neutral lighting, documentary portrait framing.

A dim cargo ship deck at night and a train car interior inset, worn suitcases stacked and being handed off between two figures, border checkpoint lights in the far distance, tense atmospheric night lighting.
A formal government hearing room, a defector seated at a witness table speaking into a microphone before a row of seated officials, official seals and flags in the background, sober formal lighting.

Motion graphic built in Remotion: three faint portrait silhouettes (Kim Il Sung, Kim Jong Il, Kim Jong Un) cross-fading into one another with a thin glowing network/circuit line pattern connecting them, suggesting an enduring financial system.
Return to the unmarked hallway door from scene 1, camera slowly pushing in closer than before, same muted lighting, quiet and unresolved, fading to black at the very end.
